logline: 쓸모없다며 버려진 짐승 넷이 음악대가 되겠다고 길을 나선다.
destination: 숲속 불 켜진 집 — 도둑들의 상이 차려진 곳
anchor: an old grey donkey with a worn back and patient eyes
palette: road ochre, deep blue, warm amber, deep green, pale silver

donkey.label: 당나귀
donkey.desc: an old grey donkey, worn back, long ears, patient dark eyes

dog.label: 개
dog.desc: an old brown hound with drooping ears and grey muzzle

cat.label: 고양이
cat.desc: a thin grey tabby cat with sharp green eyes

rooster.label: 수탉
rooster.desc: a rooster with a scarlet comb and glossy dark tail feathers

robbers.label: 도둑들
robbers.desc: rough unshaven men in patched coats and slouch hats

road.label: 시골길
road.desc: a rutted country road between hedges and far farm fields

forest.label: 숲
forest.desc: dark close-set trunks over a narrow road, dusk light

cottage_far.label: 숲속 집
cottage_far.desc: a small cottage deep in trees, one lit window, chimney smoke

beats.visual: an old grey donkey walking alone down a rutted country road, farm far behind
beats.motion: it plods steadily down the road

beats.visual: an old hound lying at the roadside lifting its head toward a passing donkey
beats.motion: the dog's head lifts steadily toward the donkey

beats.visual: a thin cat on a stone wall looking down at a donkey and a hound on the road
beats.motion: the cat's tail sweeps steadily along the wall

beats.visual: a rooster on a fence post crowing with its beak wide open, wings half spread
beats.motion: its wings beat steadily as it crows

beats.visual: a donkey, hound, cat and rooster walking together down a road toward dark woods
beats.motion: the four move steadily toward the woods

beats.visual: a dark forest road at dusk, tree shadows stretching long across the ruts
beats.motion: shadows lengthen steadily across the road

beats.beat: 나무 사이로 불 켜진 집이 보인다.
beats.visual: a lit cottage window glowing between dark tree trunks, smoke from the chimney
beats.motion: the window light glows steadily through the trees

beats.visual: four animals creeping toward a lit cottage window, low to the ground
beats.motion: they edge steadily closer to the window

beats.beat: 집 안에서는 도둑들이 상을 벌여 놓았다.
beats.visual: rough men around a table heaped with food and candles inside a cottage
beats.motion: candle flames sway steadily over the table

beats.visual: a hound on a donkey's back, a cat on the hound, a rooster on top, under a window
beats.motion: the tower sways steadily as they balance

beats.visual: four stacked animals with mouths and beak wide open at a lit window
beats.motion: their heads strain steadily toward the glass

beats.visual: rough men scattering out of a cottage door into dark trees, hats flying
beats.motion: they flee steadily into the trees

beats.visual: four animals gathered around a heaped table in warm candlelight, at ease
beats.motion: steam rises steadily from the dishes

beats.visual: a quiet cottage window under moonlight, four silhouettes resting inside
beats.motion: moonlight settles steadily on the sill

withheld: 짐승들이 그 집을 차지하고 눌러앉게 되는 결말
